security_recall_007.evidence: For a period of one (1) year after the effective date of the termination... the District shall offer to such person any position(s)... Any person selected for recall shall be given written notice of the recall. Failure to accept the position in writing within fifteen (15) calendar days of the mailing of the recall notice shall constitute forfeiture... Any educator recalled within one year under this section shall not lose any seniority

security_rif_criterion_008.answer: 3 full-contract years of service; seniority controls if qualifications are equal
security_rif_criterion_008.evidence: Certified school instructors with fewer than three (3) full-contract, consecutive years of service shall be laid off before educators having three (3) or more full-contract, consecutive years of service... Qualifications being equal, seniority in the District shall control.
